page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s6 server family. It is configured with 4 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, running on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and utilizes a shared CPU allocation model. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. The network configuration features a baseline bandwidth of 0 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to its shared CPU allocation and lack of bundled local storage, the ecs.s6-c1m2.xlarge represents a budget-oriented hardware profile. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio aligns with compute-focused entry-level workloads. However, the shared CPU model and 0 Gbps baseline network bandwidth present performance tradeoffs for resource-intensive or latency-sensitive applications. It is best suited for lightweight web serving, development environments, and non-critical background tasks that do not require sustained peak CPU performance or high network throughput.
